# json-envelope: every --json output is exactly one object with result.status and result.exit; shrink-only
# ceiling: 5
cmd/nova-fuse:bare 1 the bare command prints no --json object
cmd/nova-fuse:transcript 5 the transcript command prints no --json object
cmd/nova-fuse:unknown-flag 1 the unknown flag prints no --json object
cmd/nova-fuse:unknown-verb 1 the unknown verb prints no --json object
cmd/nova-fuse:verb-no-flags 9 the verb prints no --json object
